titles.native: ハイパーポジティブよごれモン

description:
A collaboration between FIREBUG, Fuji TV, and Bandai: Hyper Positive Yogoremon centers on Otarou, a creature themed around dirt known as a yogoremon. It and other yogoremon will ask the meaning of words and explain negative terms in positive ways. The shorts are also posted on the official CreepHyp YouTube channel.

(Source: ANN, edited)
